title: RAID HUD TYPE SIZES MERGE
why: UI step 1 of the HUD calm job (102). The critic keeps the raid screens at 2 and 3 for too many type sizes: 14 distinct word sizes in one raid frame. The vitals corner and the gun card now share one zoom (1.36, was 1.40 and 1.36), and the pillager board words are 16 px, the style guide label size (was 17). 14 sizes become 10. Nothing moves except by about 3 and 6 percent.
now: The health, stamina and status words are a hair smaller; the pillager board words are 16 px.

edits.anchor: var HUDZ={body:1.40, gear:1.36, raiders:1.15, legend:1.5, cond:1.05};
edits.replacement: var HUDZ={body:1.36, gear:1.36, raiders:1.08, legend:1.5, cond:1.05};   // v28.xx (cw-hudtype), the critic on screens 21, 19, 37, 61: 'too many type sizes'. The vitals share the gun card's 1.36 (was 1.40) so their words land on the same sizes, and the pillager board is 16 px at 1080p, the guide's label size (was 17). The top-right column (cond) stays as he placed it.
